images.author: Lucas County (Ohio). Auditor's Office
images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: Ranch houses

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a small white 1950s minimal-traditional house with a side wing and a striped metal awning over the picture window, clipped shrubs, a TV mast; a 1957 car in the drive; an open weedy lot beside it and farmland on the city's edge

why.note: leapfrog development: single houses along a road at the city edge, fields between
